observations.body: The LORD says Israel has seen speech from heaven, forbids silver and gold gods, and gives instructions for an earth or stone altar without steps.
observations.label: Heavenly speech leads to an earth altar

observations.body: Heavenly speech leads to an earth altar belongs to ten words in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 20:22–26 supplies core evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Each command remains inside one public address; later summaries and applications must not be read back into its wording without notice.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 20:22–26 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Heavenly speech leads to an earth altar belongs to the ten words movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
